summary.evidence_scope: mpv.pdb is the standalone mpv executable PDB from the same upstream workflow, not a GUID-matching PDB for libmpv-2.dll. Its source checksums corroborate shared dependency source snapshots; direct binary provenance for mpv and FFmpeg is separately embedded in the actual DLL.
